**Status:** clean fixture sidecar for lint self-tests.

---

This rules sidecar exists solely to exercise the lint script in its passing path. The body deliberately avoids any line beginning with a dash followed by a space or a numbered marker, so the list ban does not fire. The word count is also held well below the configured cap of two hundred words, ensuring the cap check reports a passing count. Reviewers reading this prose should find it boring, repetitive, and entirely free of structure beyond plain sentences arranged into a single paragraph block here.
